sql_r1_training_smoke.blocking_boundary: The pinned hybrid FSDP+vLLM stack OOMs while materializing a 130 MiB DTensor shard before the first rollout. With a 640+128 short-prompt smoke configuration, only 77 MiB was free on each 24 GB GPU.

limitations.arctic_training: Upstream releases evaluation only; training code and data-generation pipeline are not released.
limitations.sql_r1_training: Paper training used 8x80GB GPUs. The pinned upstream full-parameter hybrid trainer does not complete even a reduced one-step run on 2x24GB; reproducing training requires larger GPUs or a materially different memory strategy.
